promises.statement: IT hardware business to reach INR 6,000 crores this fiscal year

deliveredSummary: Dixon delivered rapid top-line growth (revenue up 46.7% YoY in Sep 2026), but EBITDA margin contracted to 2.7% in Sep 2026. Annual capex for FY26 met management guidance of Rs 1,138 crore.

divergences.story: Management expresses confidence in long-term growth despite near-term headwinds.
divergences.numbers: EBITDA margin dropped from 3.9% in Mar 2026 to 2.7% in Sep 2026.

divergences.story: Management highlights expanding operations and integration across key tech verticals.
divergences.numbers: Net profit YoY growth declined -44.9% in Sep 2026.

bull: Revenue grew 46.7% YoY in Sep 2026 reaching Rs 21,794 crore.
Cumulative cash conversion (CFO/Net profit) stands strong at 122%.
FY26 capex promise was kept at Rs 1,138 crore within the guided range.
bear: EBITDA margin contracted to 2.7% in Sep 2026 from 3.8% in Sep 2025.
Net profit YoY growth fell sharply by -44.9% in Sep 2026.
Borrowings increased to Rs 1,236 crore in Sep 2026 from Rs 994 crore in Mar 2026.
business: Dixon Technologies is an Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) provider manufacturing consumer electronics, lighting, home appliances, CCTV cameras, mobile phones, security equipment, wearables, and AC-PCBs, alongside reverse logistics and joint ventures for wireless audio.
